# Bukhara State Technical University International

> Official international website of Bukhara State Technical University (BSTU), providing information about international admissions, academic programs, university services, student resources, campus initiatives, and university news.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://international.bstu.uz/): Official BSTU international homepage.
- [About](https://international.bstu.uz/about): Information about Bukhara State Technical University.
- [Apply](https://international.bstu.uz/apply): International student application information.
- [Programs](https://international.bstu.uz/programs): Academic programs.
- [News](https://international.bstu.uz/news): University news.
- [Blog](https://international.bstu.uz/blog): University articles and updates.
- [Green Campus](https://international.bstu.uz/green-campus): Sustainability and Green Campus initiatives.
- [Services](https://international.bstu.uz/services): Services for international students.
- [Contact](https://international.bstu.uz/contact): Official contact information.

## International Students

- [Apply to BSTU](https://international.bstu.uz/apply): Submit or begin an international admission application.
- [Student Portal](https://international.bstu.uz/student/): Access application, documents, payments, visa, residence, contracts, notifications, and student services.

## Languages

The international website provides content in English, Uzbek, Russian, and Arabic.

## Additional Resources

- [News](https://international.bstu.uz/news): Latest official international university news.
- [Video Gallery](https://international.bstu.uz/video-bdtu): Official BSTU video content.
